description: List regular nights out and one-off events in Manchester, UK on a given date: pub quizzes, comedy, open mics, live music, club nights, drag, happy hours, social nights and film nights. Use for questions like "what's on tonight in Manchester", "comedy in the Northern Quarter on Saturday" or "quiz in Didsbury tomorrow". Each result has a time, venue, area, notes and a link to cite.

area.description: Optional area: city-centre, northern-quarter, south-manchester, didsbury, west-didsbury, chorlton, stockport, salford, further-out, or a neighbourhood name such as Ancoats, Castlefield, Levenshulme or Heaton Moor.

date.description: today (default), tonight, tomorrow, a weekday name like saturday, weekend (Friday to Sunday), a date like 31 October, halloween, bonfire night, christmas eve, YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Uses UK time, and before 4am "tonight" still means the night before.

type.description: Optional type: pub-quizzes, comedy-nights, open-mics, live-music, club-nights, drag, happy-hours, social-nights or film-nights. Plain words like "quiz" or "comedy" work too, and any other word (free, chill, theatre, family) searches the listings' descriptions. In whats_on a seasonal word (halloween, spooky, fireworks, christmas, nye) gives that season's events that day.

name: whats_on
title: What's on in Manchester
